title: tia-devops gate-enforcement boundary
decision: Accept process-enforced approval, ledger, CI, and merge integrity for tia-devops because this repository is a non-production template/reference repository with no production deployment authority. This limitation does not block approval of the tia-devops bootstrap.
accepted_risk: Within tia-devops, approval files and CI results are auditable process evidence rather than an unbypassable authorization boundary. A repository administrator or other sufficiently privileged actor could still write an approval artifact, bypass a failing check, or merge directly because GitHub branch/ruleset enforcement is not the security boundary here.
production_boundary: This risk acceptance MUST NOT transfer to ksp-platform or any repository with production deployment, promotion, secrets, or protected knowledge-pack authority.
revisit_trigger: Before any ksp-platform protected-path merge, or if tia-devops gains production authority.
ksp_platform_activation_preconditions: Protect main with a GitHub ruleset or branch protection that applies to administrators unless an explicitly documented emergency path is approved.
Require pull requests for changes to main; no routine direct pushes.
Require the merge-authoritative KSP gate through a ruleset-required workflow executed from a trusted base or pinned ref that the PR head cannot modify; a same-named status check is not equivalent.
Run the merge-authoritative GateChange checker from trusted base code only (for example pull_request_target); never checkout, source, import, or execute PR-head code in that authority workflow.

Require CODEOWNERS review by the designated human owner/maintainer for .github/workflows/**, .github/CODEOWNERS, protected-path policy, and the gate-integrity checker, with the repository ruleset enforcing that review.
Reserve merge authority for the designated human owner/maintainer; automation identities must not have merge or ruleset-bypass authority.
Use a dedicated automation identity with no repository administration permission and no branch/ruleset bypass permission.
Disallow force pushes and deletion of main.
Treat approval/ledger artifacts as evidence only; they must not by themselves grant GitHub merge authorization.

Run and retain negative enforcement tests proving the automation identity cannot merge or push to main when a required check fails and cannot bypass the ruleset; additionally prove that a PR which removes or renames the trusted gate workflow/job and a PR which adds a same-named passing job are both unmergeable.
plan_dependency: Private ksp-platform activation must not claim the GitHub-enforced preconditions are met until the Owner approves a GitHub plan or alternative enforcement design that supports them. This record authorizes no spend.
activation_block: Until every ksp-platform activation precondition above is implemented and evidenced, protected-path merge authority, Terraform apply, production promotion, and production deployment remain prohibited.
